title: LP Duality Proof Of Minimax
proof_html:
Shift the matrix by adding a positive constant to every entry, so all entries are positive. Apply finite-dimensional linear-programming duality to the dual programs $$ XA \ge \mathbf{1}, \quad X \ge 0 $$ and $$ AY \le \mathbf{1}, \quad Y \ge 0. $$ The dual optimal solutions have a common objective value $w>0$. Normalizing the vectors by $w$ gives mixed strategies $x^*$ and $y^*$, and the inequalities become the minimax optimality inequalities with value $1/w$. Undoing the constant shift gives the original game.

References

  • [MFoGT, Thm. 2.3.2 and proof after Thm. 2.3.2] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MathFoundationsGameTheory.pdf. LP duality proof of von Neumann minimax.
